properties.name: Stackpole Quay approach
properties.reason: Campervans are explicitly not permitted at Stackpole Quay because of narrow access roads. Use an alternative suitable parking/access point rather than following sat-nav to the quay.

properties.name: Broad Haven South access roads
properties.reason: National Trust states campervans are not permitted at Broad Haven South because of narrow roads. Treat the final visitor access as unsuitable for the reference campervan.

properties.name: Bosherston visitor access roads
properties.reason: National Trust states campervans are not permitted at Bosherston visitor locations because of narrow roads. Avoid relying on sat-nav for the final approach.

properties.name: Stackpole Court visitor access roads
properties.reason: Campervans are explicitly listed as not permitted at Stackpole Court due to narrow roads. Use the estate's suitable alternatives instead.

properties.name: Wray Castle final approach
properties.reason: National Trust describes narrow roads and specifically says the road approach is not recommended for motorhomes; campervan/minibus parking is also unavailable at the castle. A Transporter-sized camper may physically fit but this is a poor casual sat-nav destination.
properties.evidence: National Trust road and vehicle guidance

properties.name: Upper Booth Farm campsite lane
properties.reason: Long narrow lane with limited passing places. National Trust only accepts campervans up to 5.5 m and excludes motorhomes/caravans because of access. A 5.304 m LWB reference van is just within the published limit, leaving little length margin.
properties.evidence: National Trust explicit 5.5 m access limit

properties.name: Wauchope Forest access road
properties.reason: Forestry and Land Scotland describes a narrow access road with passing places and says the site is not suitable for caravans or large motorhomes. A Transporter-sized camper is more suitable than a large motorhome but extra care is warranted.
properties.evidence: Forestry and Land Scotland visitor guidance

properties.name: Hill Top / Near Sawrey visitor approach
properties.reason: Hill Top cannot accommodate campervans or motorhomes because parking is very limited. The surrounding B5285/B5286 roads are usable, but this destination is misleading if sat-nav is used without checking vehicle parking arrangements.
properties.evidence: National Trust campervan parking restriction; road itself not prohibited
